subject: fix test_entry to consider diffrerent allocator size classes (#3416)
reason: The change modifies only the unit test file src/unit/test_entry.cpp: it skips the entryUpdate gtest when jemalloc is not the allocator and lengthens two test strings so the test's size-class assumptions hold. No runtime server, command, replication, persistence, or tool behavior changes, so there is nothing a fuzzer scenario could exercise or compare across builds.
